text: `ChartCard exportAppearance="text"` (and `ChartExport appearance="text"`) draws the download control as a quiet "Export" link, a 16px glyph beside the word in subtle text, as the SMILE – Beggary dashboard handoff draws it. For pages where several charts sit side by side and a row of download icons outweighs their titles. Its accessible name begins with the visible word. The default, the icon alone, is unchanged.
